description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring this student property to the rental market, ideally situated in a popular student area.

Offering spacious accommodation, the property features four double bedrooms, a large kitchen and a generous reception area, providing plenty of room for relaxing and socialising with housemates. With its practical layout and student-friendly location, this property is an excellent option for those looking for comfortable shared accommodation.

A bills package is also available, offering added convenience when organising your student household expenses.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team!
